chapter.verse: Iconium khua ah zong thu a kibang mah piang hi. Jew vengkhawm inn ah Paul leh Barnabas lut uh a, amau' thugen dan tungtawnin Jew leh Greek a nih tuakun mihon tampi in um uh hi.
Ahih hangin Jew mi thu-umlote in Gentile mite holhthawh uh a, sanggamte' tungah lungsim thangpaisak uh hi.

Tua hangin amaute tawlpikhat taamsuak uh a, Topa' hehpihna thu hangtak genkhia uh hi. Topa in zong amau' thugente maan cih teci a panna-in kihilna lim lamdangte amau' khut tawh bawl theih ding pia hi.
Ahih hangin khuasung mipite lungsim kikak uh a, kimkhat Jew mite' lamah, kimkhat sawltakte' lamah om uh hi.
Gentile mite leh Jew mite a nih tuakun a uliante uh tawh kopin sawltakte khelbawl ding leh suang tawh den ding a sawm vat uh ciangin
sawltakte in na thei uh a, Lycaonia gam Lystra leh Derbe khuate leh a kimkot ah tai uh hi.
Tua takah zong Lungdamna Thu tangko uh hi.
Tu-in Lystra khua ah a khe a zang theilo, a suah-a kipan khezaw-in lampai ngeilo mi khat, tu hi.
Paul a pau laitak tua mipa in thungai hi. Paul in amah limtak enin damna ngahthei ding upna nei cih a muh ciangin
awging lianpi tawh, “Na khe-in tangtak dingto in,” ci hi. Tua mipa zong diangto-in lampai kipan hi.
Mihonpi in Paul' nasep a muh uh ciangin a awte uh sangkhan Lycaonia pau tawh, “Ei' kiangah pasiante mihing tawh kisunin hong paisuk uh,” ci uh hi.
Amaute in Barnabas pen Zeus ci uh a, Paul pen thugenpi ahih manin Hermes ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin khuamual mai-a om Zeus thoihna innpi pana siampipa in mihonpi tawh gangawh biakpiak bawl nuamin khuakulh kongkhakpite ah bawngtal leh biakpiak paaklomte hong keng hi.
Ahih hangin sawltakte Barnabas leh Paul in a zak uh ciangin a puantual uh balkekin mihonpi lakah kikhawhphei uh a,

“Lawmte aw, bang hangin hih bang bawl na hi uh hiam? Ko zong note tawh pianzia a kibang mihing mah ka hi uh a, kimanna neilo hih nate nusia-in vantung, leitung leh tuate' sunga om khempeuh a bawl a nungta Pasian' kiangah na kihei nadingun Lungdamna Thu hong tangko ka hi uh hi.
Khanghun paisate ah Pasian in Gentile mi khempeuh amau' ut tek zuisak hi.

Ahi zongin ama' thu teci omlo ahih ding amahmah kiphal lo-in nahoih hong sem hi. Note' tungah van guahtui leh gahleteh a piangsak khuahunte hong pia a, na lungsim uh annek tuidawn leh nuamna tawh hong kidimsak hi,” ci uh hi.
Amau' tungah gangawh biakpiak a bawl loh nadingun hih thute tawh mihonpite kho zo liailiai uh hi.
Ahih hangin Antioch leh Iconium pan Jew mite hong pai-in mihonpite a zol khit uh ciangin Paul suang tawh deng uh a, a si ta sa uh ahih manin khuapi sungpan kaikhia uh hi.
Ahih hangin Paul' kiangah nungzuite hong kikaihkhop laitakun amah dingto-in khuasung lut a, a zingciangin Barnabas tawh Derbe paisuak uh hi.
Tua khuapi ah Lungdamna Thu tangko-in nungzui tamkhop a suahsak khit uh ciangin Lystra, Iconium leh Antioch khuate ah ciahkik uh hi.
Nungzuite' nunna kha thahatsakin upna sungah a kipsuak nadingun hanthawn uh a, gentheihna tampi tungtawnin Pasian' kumpigam i lut kul ding cih thu gen uh hi.
Pawlpi sim ah makaite a koih khit uh ciangin amaute' up ahi Topa' kepna sungah thungetna leh antanna tawh ap uh hi.
Tua ciangin Pisidia gam nawkin Pamphylia gam tung uh hi.
Perga khua ah thu a gen khit uh ciangin Attalia khua ah paisuk uh hi.
Tua tak panin a tangtut khitsa uh nasep a kipat ding lai-un Pasian' hehpihna a sanna mun uh ahi Antioch ah tembaw tawh pai uh hi.
A tun uh ciangin pawlpi kaikhawm uh a, amau' tungtawna Pasian' sep thute khempeuh leh Gentile mite' tungah upna kongpi a honsakna thu zasak uh hi.
Tua ciangin nungzuite tawh tawlpikhat sung taam uh hi.
